sentences.en: Many astronomers assume that the universe continues to expand forever.
sentences.zh: 许多天文学家认为宇宙会永远膨胀下去。

sentences.en: Clyde dreamed of going to college and becoming an astronomer.
sentences.zh: 克莱德梦想着上大学成为一名天文学家。

sentences.en: Hubble also helped astronomers analyze the atmospheres of extrasolar planets.
sentences.zh: 哈勃还帮助天文学家分析系外行星的大气层。
